title: Allow public read-only unified content search

spec.problem: Public dictionary, Kanji and grammar pages work anonymously, but their unified search form receives 401 from an unexpectedly learner-guarded read-only endpoint.

acceptance.text: An anonymous GET /api/search with a query and content scope returns HTTP 200 with the canonical SearchResult array.
Authenticated learner search retains the same results and JLPT enrichment; indexing remains restricted to Admin.
The visible anonymous search form displays results for ために at 390x844 rather than the generic unavailable state.

spec.expected_behavior: Anonymous and authenticated callers can read the same public content-search results; POST indexing remains Admin-only.
spec.observed_behavior: Fresh anonymous browser submitted ために; GET /api/search returned 401 and the UI displayed Chưa thể tìm kiếm lúc này. Authenticated searches succeed.
spec.rollback_plan: Restore learnerGuard around GET /api/search and reinstate the anonymous 401 test if this endpoint is found to expose user-specific data.

risk_acknowledgements.reason: This legacy integration check is skipped only when TEST_MEILISEARCH_URL is absent; the same public anonymous route is exercised unconditionally by TestSearchRouteIsPublicWithoutSessionStore with an httptest Meilisearch stub. The expected skip remains explicit and is not used as a substitute for coverage.
